## Blogs

**[Clinical Failure Rates Over the Decades: Yikes](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/clinical-failure-rates-over-decades-yikes)** — *Science.org*  
- Analysis of a new paper compiling clinical failure rates from the 1960s through the 2010s: 90% (1960s), 81% (1970s), 80% (1980s), 88% (1990s), 91% (2000s), 91% (2010s).  
- The 1970s–80s dip coincides with the pre-molecular-biology era; author speculates phenotypic/animal-model approaches and “low-hanging fruit” targets may have contributed.  
- Conclusion: the ~90% failure rate of the last three decades is robust; reverting to older techniques is unlikely to restore lower attrition.

## News

**[Sanofi halts development of amlitelimab in atopic dermatitis](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/sanofi-amlitelimab-atopic-dermatitis-eczema-shelved/826132/)** — *BioPharma Dive*  
- Sanofi shelves the OX40L inhibitor amlitelimab (acquired via $1.1B Kymab buy) after mixed Phase 3 efficacy and Kaposi’s sarcoma cases.  
- Development continues in celiac disease; mid-stage data expected by year-end.  
- Amgen/Kyowa Kirin recently abandoned the similar OX40L antibody rocatinlimab over comparable safety/efficacy concerns.

**[Novo seeks injunction against Lilly GLP-1 ads; J&J bispecifics cut myeloma progression/death by 89%](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/novo-lawsuit-talvey-tecvayli-daraxonrasib-etcamah-ehlers-formation/825993/)** — *BioPharma Dive*  
- Novo Nordisk filed for a preliminary injunction to halt Eli Lilly’s “misleading” obesity-drug advertising (Zepbound/Mounjaro vs. Wegovy/Ozempic).  
- J&J’s Talvey + Tecvayli + pomalidomide reduced progression/death risk by 89% and death risk by 62% in 1–4 prior-line multiple myeloma — best bispecific data to date.  
- FDA accepted Revolution Medicines’ NDA for daraxonrasib (pancreatic cancer) with a priority-review voucher.

**[Merck strikes voluntary licenses for experimental HIV prevention pill in low-income countries](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/07/24/merck-experimental-hiv-prevention-pill-licensing-deals/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*  
- Merck is licensing its investigational HIV-prevention pill broadly to enable rapid, wide-scale production in poor countries.  
- Deal terms undisclosed; aim is to accelerate access if/when approved.

**[FDA advisory panel backs compounding of four peptide drugs](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/07/24/fda-panel-peptides-merck-hiv-pill-license/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*  
- An FDA advisory committee recommended allowing compounding pharmacies to prepare four peptide drugs — a win for peptide-access advocates.

**[U.S. measles cases in 2026 already exceed all of 2025](https://www.statnews.com/2026/07/24/measles-cases-surpass-2025-total-national-vaccination-rate-now-below-key-threshold/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*  
- National vaccination rate has fallen below the 95% threshold needed for herd immunity; outbreak trajectory accelerating.

**[Fatal gene-editing trial in China raises ethics/oversight questions](https://www.statnews.com/2026/07/24/biotech-news-fatal-gene-editing-trial-in-china-raises-ethics-questions/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*  
- A patient death in a Chinese gene-editing study has triggered scrutiny of regulatory oversight and informed-consent practices.

**[Separate *Cyclospora* outbreak reported](https://www.statnews.com/2026/07/24/health-news-new-separate-cyclospora-diarrhea-outbreak/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*  
- New cluster of the diarrheal parasite identified, distinct from earlier outbreaks.

**[Pharma personnel moves](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/07/24/up-and-down-the-ladder-rigel-sanofi-pharma-jobs/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*  
- Recent executive hires, departures, and promotions at Rigel, Sanofi, and others.

## Papers & Preprints

**[Rocbrutinib, a Highly Selective Fourth-Generation Covalent and Noncovalent BTK Inhibitor, in R/R Non-GCB DLBCL: Phase I](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496861/)** — *PubMed*  
- First-in-human data for rocbrutinib (dual covalent/noncovalent BTK binding) in relapsed/refractory non-GCB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

**[SERENA-6: Camizestrant for Emerging *ESR1m* Advanced Breast Cancer on First-Line Endocrine Therapy](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496653/)** — *PubMed*  
- Patient-reported outcomes and safety from the Phase 3 SERENA-6 trial of the oral SERD camizestrant in *ESR1*-mutated HR+/HER2− advanced breast cancer.

**[Povorcitinib for Hidradenitis Suppurativa: STOP-HS1 and STOP-HS2 Phase 3 Trials](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04534-z)** — *Nature Medicine*  
- Oral JAK1 inhibitor povorcitinib met primary endpoints, significantly reducing abscesses and inflammatory nodules vs. placebo in moderate-to-severe HS.

**[Phase I/IIa Trial of Automated (⁶⁸Ga)-PSMA-11 Production via Cyclotron-Generated (⁶⁸Ga)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496850/)** — *PubMed*  
- Validates a new automated synthesis module for the PSMA PET tracer, potentially simplifying radiopharmacy workflow.

**[Targeting T Follicular Helper Cells for Lifelong Health](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41573-026-01495-3)** — *Nature Reviews Drug Discovery*  
- Review of therapeutic strategies to modulate TFH cells: enhancing for vaccines/infectious disease, inhibiting for autoimmunity, cancer, and allergy.

**[AI Clinician Decision Support (Retina4IRD) for Inherited Retinal Disease Diagnosis: Multicenter RCT](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04545-w)** — *Nature Medicine*  
- Multimodal imaging + clinical data AI achieved 88.5% diagnostic accuracy in a randomized trial, outperforming unaided clinicians.

**[LITMUS Imaging Study: Prospective Validation of Serum vs. Imaging Biomarkers for MASH/Fibrosis](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04496-2)** — *Nature Medicine*  
- Serum biomarkers outperformed imaging for identifying at-risk MASH patients; elastography remained superior for staging advanced fibrosis/cirrhosis.

**[Blood circRNA Signature for Early Alzheimer’s Detection](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04563-8)** — *Nature Medicine*  
- Circular RNA panel from blood detects AD on par with or better than current biomarkers and predicts future symptomatic conversion.

**[EGFR-TKI–Associated Interstitial Lung Disease: Drug-Specific Timing and Fatality Patterns (JADER Database)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496703/)** — *PubMed*  
- Pharmacovigilance analysis reveals distinct onset latency and mortality profiles across EGFR inhibitors in NSCLC.

**[Comparison of Non-Insulin Glucose-Lowering Therapies on Coronary Plaque Progression in Diabetes](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496918/)** — *PubMed*  
- Comparative effectiveness imaging study assessing atherosclerotic plaque trajectories across drug classes.

**[Probiotics as Anti–*P. aeruginosa* Biofilm Agents](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496927/)** — *PubMed*  
- Screening identifies probiotic strains that disrupt *Pseudomonas* biofilms, suggesting a non-antibiotic adjunctive strategy.

**[Systems Pharmacology: *Leuconostoc mesenteroides* Neuroprotection in an *In Vitro* AD Model](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496889/)** — *PubMed*  
- Transcriptomic profiling implicates the probiotic *L. mesenteroides* in modulating AD-relevant pathways.

**[Treg-Derived Exosomal miR-146a Sustains Immunosuppressive TME via CAF Crosstalk](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496815/)** — *PubMed*  
- Mechanistic study linking Treg exosomes to cancer-associated fibroblast reprogramming and immune evasion.

**[Cost-Effectiveness of Bivalent RSV Prefusion F Vaccine in Dutch Older Adults](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496785/)** — *PubMed*  
- Health-economic model evaluates the new RSV vaccine in the Netherlands’ elderly population.

**[Blood Proteome Predicts Circulating-Factor Impact on Age-Related Mitochondrial Health](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41514-026-00449-8)** — *npj Aging*  
- Proteomic clock links plasma factors to mitochondrial functional decline with age.

**[Royal Jelly Ameliorates Age-Associated Stem Cell Dysfunction via Chi3l1/CD206+ Macrophages](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41514-026-00454-x)** — *npj Aging*  
- Royal jelly rejuvenates aged stem cells in mice through a Chi3l1-dependent increase in reparative macrophages.

**[FOSL2-Driven SASP in Endometrial Stroma Fuels Endometriosis Inflammation](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41514-026-00447-w)** — *npj Aging*  
- FOSL2-mediated senescence-associated secretory phenotype identified as a driver of endometriosis pathology.

**[SP/NK1 Receptor Axis Blockade Confers Multimodal Neuroprotection in Global Cerebral Ischemia](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496765/)** — *PubMed*  
- Preclinical evidence for anti-inflammatory, hypoxic, and lymphovascular mechanisms of NK1 antagonism.

**[T3 and Curcumin Suppress Amyloid-β via TGFβ1-Sp1/Collagen-IV/VI Regulation in Hypothyroid Mice](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496756/)** — *PubMed*  
- Thyroid hormone and curcumin converge on TGFβ1-Sp1 signaling to reduce amyloid deposition.

**[EMT Hub Signature Associated with Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Progression](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496704/)** — *PubMed*  
- Transcriptomic network analysis nominates an EMT-related gene signature prognostic for NPC.

**[Camizestrant SERENA-6: Visual PROs and Safety in *ESR1m* Advanced Breast Cancer](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496653/)** — *PubMed*  
- (Duplicate of above SERENA-6 entry; merged.)

**[DREAM-NP: Real-World Dual Remission in Severe Asthma + Nasal Polyps (Phase IV)](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496183/)** — *PubMed*  
- Multicenter observational study of biologic-treated patients achieving simultaneous control of both indications.

**[Survival Disparities by Race/Ethnicity in Relapsed/Refractory Pediatric/Young Adult Hodgkin Lymphoma](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42496647/)** — *PubMed*  
- Pooled COG trial analysis quantifies outcome gaps across racial/ethnic groups.

## X / Twitter

**[Brad Loncar (@bradloncar): Alexis Borisy comments on China biotech debate](https://x.com/bradloncar/status/2080660177435414832)** — *X / Brad Loncar*  
- Unverified conference remarks from EQRx founder Alexis Borisy on China-related biotech strategy; treat as perspective, not fact.

**[BioStocks (@BioStocks): Amgen disputes FDA proposal to withdraw TAVNEOS](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2080628562134970568)** — *X / BioStocks*  
- Amgen “strongly disagrees” with FDA’s withdrawal proposal for the ANCA vasculitis drug; formal response pending.

**[BioStocks (@BioStocks): ZVRA receives negative CHMP opinion for arimoclomol in Niemann-Pick Type C](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2080624728121778211)** — *X / BioStocks*  
- European regulatory setback for the heat-shock protein amplifier; unconfirmed until company/EMA statement.

**[BioStocks (@BioStocks): MNKD $50M PIPE at $3.89/share](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2080603052612972579)** — *X / BioStocks*  
- Private investment in public equity for MannKind; terms per filing.

**[BioStocks (@BioStocks): MNKD FDA approval of Furoscix ReadyFlow](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2080601809073086491)** — *X / BioStocks*  
- First autoinjector delivering IV-equivalent furosemide for edema in heart failure/CKD; confirm via FDA Orange Book.

**[BioStocks (@BioStocks): NVO seeks preliminary injunction vs. LLY obesity/diabetes ads](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2080595791182283214)** — *X / BioStocks*  
- Mirrors BioPharma Dive report; court motion filed Friday seeking immediate halt to Lilly’s comparative advertising.

---

**Worth watching:** Sanofi’s celiac pivot for amlitelimab (data by year-end), J&J’s bispecific triplet regulatory filing timeline, and whether povorcitinib’s HS label expands JAK1 competition beyond upadacitinib.

- Pure Science
    - [How Fast Is the Universe Really Expanding? | PODCAST: The Joy of Why](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Srcz66KUDbY) -- Quanta Magazine
        - Adam Riess traces his path from graduate student to Nobel laureate, detailing how Type Ia supernovae serve as standardizable candles for measuring cosmic distances via the distance ladder (Cepheid variables, tip of the red giant branch, and supernovae in the same host galaxies).
        - The 1998 discovery that distant supernovae were dimmer than expected revealed the universe’s expansion is accelerating, reviving Einstein’s cosmological constant as the leading explanation for dark energy within the ΛCDM model.
        - The Hubble tension now centers on a ~9% discrepancy: the local distance-ladder measurement yields H₀ ≈ 73 km/s/Mpc, while the CMB-inferred ΛCDM value is ≈ 67 km/s/Mpc — a difference that exceeds 5σ and cannot be explained by known systematic errors.
        - Riess outlines how new telescopes (JWST, Roman, ground-based ELTs) are targeting multiple independent distance anchors — Cepheids, TRGB, JAGB stars, and gravitational-wave standard sirens — to cross-check the distance ladder and test whether early-universe physics or new dark-energy dynamics resolve the tension.
        - The tension may indicate physics beyond ΛCDM, such as early dark energy, neutrino self-interactions, or a running Planck mass, but Riess emphasizes that exhaustive systematic checks on the distance-ladder side continue before invoking new cosmology.
